body:
accountId is only stored at login; a session that logged in before v1.2.0 has
accountId=null, so SyncEngine.reportCollaboratorChanges() returns early and no
collaborator-change notification ever fires — a silent failure with no re-login
prompt. There's no /me endpoint, but the members list (lists/{id}/members)
returns account_id + email, and the client knows its own accountEmail. Backfill
accountId in SyncEngine (best-effort, when null) by fetching any local list's
members and matching the email, so it self-heals in the background worker.
title: Android: self-heal a missing accountId so pre-v1.2.0 sessions can detect collaborator changes
